session_1758607144504_1mrxk34: To what extent do you support or oppose the widespread deployment of surveillance cameras in public spaces? Please explain your reasoning.
column3: I can see both sides of the issue. I, in some ways, support it, in some ways, oppose it. Support it because it could deter crime. It can also catch a criminal after something has happened. And I oppose it because it is an invasion of privacy. You shouldn't be filmed everywhere you go. That's definitely an invasion of privacy.

session_1758607144504_1mrxk34: What do you think are the most significant impacts, positive or negative, of increasing surveillance camera coverage in urban areas?
column3: I think positive impacts are, as I mentioned before, a deterrent to crime and it can help catch someone who has committed a crime or even track a person who is vulnerable either in a mental health crisis or someone who has been kidnapped, a child maybe. Those things can all definitely help and are positive and they are reasons I would support surveillance cameras, but again, in marginalized areas, lower income, they can use it, they can target people and that is definitely a negative.

session_1758607144504_1mrxk34: How do you think surveillance technologies might affect public safety and crime rates?
column3: I think it can infect public safety. If they could catch people that are doing the crime because they have a way to identify them through surveillance, that would lower crime rates, I would think.

session_1758607144504_1mrxk34: What impact do you believe increased surveillance might have on personal privacy and individual liberties?
column3: I think it's a negative impact on personal privacy and individual liberty. People should be able to go where they want to go and do what they want to do and not be filmed all the time. I think that is definitely an invasion of privacy.

session_1758607144504_1mrxk34: How do you think surveillance camera systems might affect community trust and police-community relations?

There would maybe be more accountability if either side did something that was unnecessary, uncalled for, illegal. I think that could help improve relations just to have a way to hold people accountable.
